svg.text: learn-crossplane — Kubernetes-native DevOps platform on LocalStack
AWS Cloud — emulated by LocalStack Pro, single gateway :4566, routed by Host header
everything inside is synced by ArgoCD from gitops/
polls outbound — no webhook can cross the NAT
48 managed resources · reconciled forever, drift corrected
git is the source of truth
traceparent rides in the Kafka header — end-to-end traces with no tracing code
